instruction: You are the inventory control manager for Northstar Controls. Resolve FACTORYBENCH-059 (Return excess project copper to common stock). Verify project completion and finance release before moving residual project-owned inventory to common stores. The case is an isolated snapshot as of 2026-01-12; correlate immutable IDs and effective revisions rather than matching names alone. Evidence is distributed across Oracle Fusion, Gmail, Drive, Sheets, and Slack, with inspectable files including `operating-policy.md`, `contract-or-service-control.md`, `supplier-quotation.pdf`, `supplier-lead-time-and-capacity.xlsx`, `approval-decision-log.csv`, `source-email-thread.eml`, `operations-slack-thread.json`, `drive-approval-record.json`. After the documented Oracle operation, create the requested email draft without sending it; then add the Oracle result as a Drive comment. Return exactly: inventory_transaction, from_to_location, controlled_quantity.

# Return excess project copper to common stock — operating control

Scope: Correct and move lot-, serial-, project-, and organization-controlled inventory through documented transactions.

The operator must reconcile the authoritative ERP record with the named collaboration and document evidence. A write is permitted only after the record identity, effective revision, quantity or amount, and recorded approval agree. Preserve task, lot, serial, supplier, project, and work-order references. Communicate the resulting identifier and effective date; never infer approval from silence.
